========================================
dot-prefixed selectors from class dumps
========================================

@interface B
- (void).cxx_destruct;
@end
---

(translation_unit
  (class_interface
    (identifier)
    (method_declaration
      (method_type
        (type_name
          (primitive_type)))
      (identifier))))

========================================
anonymous enum and forward struct in ivars
========================================

@interface C {
    enum { kMax = 100, };
    NSMutableArray* _j;
    struct _opaque_pthread_rwlock_t;
}
@end
---

(translation_unit
  (class_interface
    (identifier)
    (instance_variables
      (instance_variable
        (enum_specifier
          body: (enumerator_list
            (enumerator
              name: (identifier)
              value: (number_literal)))))
      (instance_variable
        (struct_declaration
          (type_identifier)
          (struct_declarator
            (pointer_declarator
              declarator: (identifier)))))
      (instance_variable
        (struct_specifier
          name: (type_identifier))))))

========================================
macro attribute between declarator and =
========================================

void f(){
    SEL selector __unused = 0;
}
---

(translation_unit
  (function_definition
    type: (primitive_type)
    declarator: (function_declarator
      declarator: (identifier)
      parameters: (parameter_list))
    body: (compound_statement
      (declaration
        type: (typedefed_specifier)
        declarator: (init_declarator
          declarator: (identifier)
          (macro_attribute)
          value: (number_literal))))))
